description: Implement binary search on a sorted list. The function has iContract preconditions (list is sorted) and postconditions (if result >= 0, element at that index equals the target; if result == -1, target is not in the list).
test_cases:
assert binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 5) == 2
assert binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 4) == -1
assert binary_search([], 1) == -1
print('All tests passed!')
